Dev, build e02167f, agent unit U85 (devSpec of TC-15/S04). Preset "Any urgent pending tasks?" asked once on each seeded chart (each chart: one open task flagged urgent, one open unflagged, one done). The oracle's substring checks passed (flagged task named, done task absent; Q2 record: the unflagged task was listed too), but the answer is wrong on the Nursing Home chart: it says "there are no urgent tasks documented" and lists the flagged task "Recheck weight Friday" as "routine follow-up, not time-sensitive" next to the unflagged one. Judged against U1 (each preset returns a correct, patient-specific answer; then: the answer names the flagged open task), so failed on the Nursing Home half. Hospital half: "Call ID re: blood cultures today" was called urgent and "Repeat chest X-ray tomorrow" non-urgent, which matches the flags, but only by inference from 'today' / 'tomorrow'. Cause (code reading, the review's Q2 candidate): the Ask context sends the pending tasks as text only and drops the urgent flag in both contexts (src/features/rounding/patient/askContext.ts:115-118; the Nursing Home ask uses the same builder), so the model cannot know which task the physician flagged. Also recorded for Preston (3.4): added clinical reasoning ("the blood culture follow-up is the priority to guide antibiotic therapy") and documentation-status narration. descriptionHtml:
Candidate N7 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Ask AI does not know which task is flagged urgent: 'Any urgent pending tasks?' in Nursing Home answers that there are none

Tickets: TFA-92593 AC 4 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: local

Note: The urgent flag never reaches the model (askContext.ts:115-118). The dev agent judged it; Quinn to confirm.

Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S04 Preset 'urgent pending tasks' with one flagged task (Hospital; NH variant)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each of the six quick-question presets (today's labs, current medications, pre-round note contents, urgent pending tasks, current diagnosis, symptoms mentioned) returns a correct, patient-specific an … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 4)
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 3; UAT 3.4)
  • T4 TC-15 AI checks pass per ground rule 3.2, graded against Vikram's EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md. The substring checks in this matrix are a pre-screen, not that grading. (TFA-94229 AC 2; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Patient with one urgent-flagged open task, one unflagged open task and one done task

When Ask preset "Any urgent pending tasks?"

Then Answer names the flagged open task and not the completed one

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Flagged task present, done task absent (U1). Whether the unflagged task is listed is recorded, not judged (Q2). The context drops the urgent flag (askContext.ts), so a miss here is a candidate finding, not a known gap

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Preset 'urgent pending tasks' with one flagged task (Hospital; NH variant)

Tickets: TFA-92593 Ask AI (ready for qa); TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress)

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Dev, build e02167f, agent unit U85 (devSpec of TC-15/S04). Preset "Any urgent pending tasks?" asked once on each seeded chart (each chart: one open task flagged urgent, one open unflagged, one done). The oracle's substring checks passed (flagged task named, done task absent; Q2 record: the unflagged task was listed too), but the answer is wrong on the Nursing Home chart: it says "there are no urgent tasks documented" and lists the flagged task "Recheck weight Friday" as "routine follow-up, not time-sensitive" next to the unflagged one. Judged against U1 (each preset returns a correct, patient-specific answer; then: the answer names the flagged open task), so failed on the Nursing Home half. Hospital half: "Call ID re: blood cultures today" was called urgent and "Repeat chest X-ray tomorrow" non-urgent, which matches the flags, but only by inference from 'today' / 'tomorrow'. Cause (code reading, the review's Q2 candidate): the Ask context sends the pending tasks as text only and drops the urgent flag in both contexts (src/features/rounding/patient/askContext.ts:115-118; the Nursing Home ask uses the same builder), so the model cannot know which task the physician flagged. Also recorded for Preston (3.4): added clinical reasoning ("the blood culture follow-up is the priority to guide antibiotic therapy") and documentation-status narration. T4 (the 3.2 grade, EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md) belongs to TFA-94229 (in progress): todo, not judged. Rows: 2 deleted, 0 left, no other row changed.

Product issue: Asked 'Any urgent pending tasks?' on a Nursing Home resident with a task the physician flagged urgent ('Recheck weight Friday'), Ask AI answers that there are no urgent tasks and calls that task routine and not time-sensitive. The urgent flag never reaches the model (task text only), so any answer about urgency is a guess.

Evidence: 4 attached; 2 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/tc15-s04-u85/s04-h-tasks.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/tc15-s04-u85/s04-n-tasks.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
